design: From scratch, NO warm start: dense vs MoE (learned gate), 10764 steps = one epoch on tokens-v4, seed 5489 both arms, --ddp 2 one board, 22 validation points each. Paired: identical data order, so per-step oscillation cancels.
why_this_run_exists: The four-arm warm-started experiment could not answer whether MoE overtakes dense: every MoE arm carried 204 fresh parameters against a converged feed-forward, so the whole dense-vs-MoE gap was initialization debt. From scratch there is no debt and the comparison is of architectures.
verdict: MoE lower (better) than dense; effect grows over training.
honest_reading: MoE here has 3.62x TOTAL parameters at 0.989x ACTIVE compute, so this is the ordinary MoE bargain -- more parameters for the same compute helped. It is NOT evidence about die geography: gate policy was measured separately in the four-arm run, where seeding the gate from the die map bought nothing measurable (+0.0044 nats, signs 8+/7-) and freezing it to physical address cost only 0.0118.
caveat: One seed per arm. The paired design makes the delta precise, but a second seed would be needed to rule out a seed-specific interaction.
